title: Treatise on Armor-Cracking Spike Work
summary: Teaches Champions to drive qi through the spikes so a morning star breaks plate and mail instead of glancing.

title: Canon of the Crushing Crown Strokes
summary: Sets out the heavy head strokes of the spiked ball for Xiantian students whose qi now extends past the body.

title: Handbook of Shield-Splitting Orb Work
summary: Trains Champions in breaking shield rims, binding boards and crushing the arms behind them with a qi-loaded orb.

title: Treatise on Qi-Laden Spike Landings
summary: Describes how the field of qi is gathered into one spike at the instant of landing for deep, narrow wounds.

title: Twin-Track Spiked Orb Manual
summary: Teaches the dual-track habit of pairing a heavy head stroke with a guard from the same shaft, for Champions.

title: Treatise on the Paired Hawk-Head Strokes
summary: Develops the stooping strokes of the spiked head in pairs, one high and one low, for Xiantian students.

title: Azure Basin Spike Drill of the Dual Tracks
summary: A compact drill that runs two linked tracks of qi through shaft and head, taught to Xiantian students.

title: Wind-Sworn Plateau Orb Handbook
summary: Teaches the open-ground orb strokes of the wind-sworn, relying on long strides and the shaft's reach.

title: Bearing-Taken Spike Treatise
summary: Shows how a bearing taken on the foe is held through every swing, so the spikes land where the wielder aimed.

title: Gale Edge Canon of the Oath-Struck Orb
summary: Sets out the long-reach orb strokes of the Gale tradition, each struck as if sworn to the wind.
